# Bundled document libraries

These browser distributions are bundled for local operation; the app makes no
runtime CDN requests. Retain the adjacent original license notices.

- jsPDF 2.5.1 — jspdf.umd.min.js; MIT; JSPDF-LICENSE.
- PDF.js (pdfjs-dist) 4.10.38 — pdf.min.mjs and pdf.worker.min.mjs; Apache 2.0;
  PDFJS-LICENSE. Requires a modern browser and an HTTP/HTTPS origin.
- Mammoth 1.9.0 — mammoth.browser.min.js; BSD-2-Clause; MAMMOTH-LICENSE.

Only raw editable text is extracted from Word; uploaded document HTML is never
inserted into the page. Uploaded files are processed locally.
